OBSERVED ROUTER INTEROPERABILITY DEFECT
- ChatGPT Android rendered/copied the manager response as one flattened paragraph:
  ROUTE_TASK PROJECT_ID: SMT ROUTE_ID: SMT-TEST-058A-001 FROM: 00 TARGET: 04 ... RETURN_TO: 00 END_ROUTE_TASK
- 058a accepted only sentinels occupying independent lines.
- Therefore the manager response was semantically valid but transport-incompatible with the 058a parser.

058b-r2 FIX
- Preserve exact multiline protocol support.
- Add strict compact whole-response parsing for ROUTE_TASK, PROJECT_UPDATE, PROJECT_MANIFEST.
- Multiple compact ROUTE_TASK blocks remain supported.
- No fuzzy extraction: compact control is accepted only when the entire copied assistant payload is protocol block(s), with strict sentinel order and scalar cardinality.
- During final multidimensional review, exact multiline protocol was additionally hardened: code-fenced examples, explanatory prose around a block, and duplicated authority-bearing scalar fields now fail closed.
- Exact multiline result envelope + route behavior remains supported after router-owned result envelope removal.
- Dynamic Project/Agent Registry remains data-driven; no fixed SMT/01..12 target table was reintroduced.
- 058a goal-terminal/watchdog fixes remain frozen.
- 057a cancellation/lifecycle invariants remain frozen.
- PREPARED/ATTEMPTED and no-blind-replay route/return semantics remain frozen.
- Exact ChatGPT title/composer/send grounding remains frozen.
- Single physical Android UI owner remains frozen.
- Router ORCH_V58 diagnostics are persisted to getExternalFilesDir("closepaw-diagnostics")/project-router-v58.log so the existing diagnostics export includes routing decisions.
